name: live-view
summary: A plugin's self-owned live-preview egress: demand-gated, content-deduped, viewport-cropped JPEG streaming. Parasitic (doc 37) — no owner identity, no cap registration; bills the host plugin.

native.delivery: header — #include'd into the host plugin DLL at compile time

ui.delivery: TS module — bundled into the webui at build time

viewportFeedback.upstream: widget -> expose: ViewportMessage, carried as expose's `viewport` exchange command {command:'viewport',channel,x,y,w,h}
viewportFeedback.downstream: expose -> native: 'viewport' key (x,y,w,h CSV) in the xi.ui.sink probe reply
viewportFeedback.status: LANDED end-to-end. expose relays per-channel viewport (stored only while subscribed, returned in the probe reply); LiveView::demand_() reads it and crops. Verified by cap_ui_egress_test 'VIEWPORT RELAY' section.

ui.note: SOURCE form — the webui build compiles these; the plet ships no artifact.
